name: exact_calc
description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression exactly over fractions: 0.1 + 0.2 is 3/10, 2**100 has every digit, binomials and factorials are exact. Parsed into a syntax tree with a whitelist, never eval. Irrational results (sqrt of a non-square, pi, ln, exp, trig) come out as decimals at a chosen precision, marked inexact.

expression.description: + - * / // % ** (or ^), parentheses, and sqrt abs floor ceil trunc round min max gcd lcm factorial binomial perm ln log log10 exp sin cos tan atan, pi, e

variables.description: Names to substitute, numbers or decimal strings

precision.description: Significant digits of the decimal rendering

catalog.source: original; Python fractions and decimal, ast whitelist evaluation
